  <main class="content-panel">
    <h1>Docs in Motion</h1>

    <p class="deck">A stylized documentation dashboard with notes, cards, and workflow elements.</p>

    <p>Welcome to a small Quarto-based documentation website built to showcase practical writing, publishing workflows, and clear information design.</p>

    <p>This project is organized around three standalone documentation articles that focus on how teams create useful documents, maintain high-quality technical writing, and publish content in a way that is easy to find and easy to trust.</p>

    <h2>Why documentation matters</h2>

    <p>Clear documentation reduces confusion, speeds up onboarding, and creates trust across technical teams and customers.</p>

    <h2>Featured articles</h2>

    <ul>
      <li>[Planning documentation that people actually use](docs/articles/article-1.qmd)</li>
      <li>[Writing concise, readable technical content](docs/articles/article-2.qmd)</li>
      <li>[Publishing a static documentation site with Quarto](docs/articles/article-3.qmd)</li>
    </ul>

    <h2>What this site demonstrates</h2>

    <p>It shows how a simple documentation set can feel polished, readable, and structured without relying on heavy frameworks or a cluttered interface.</p>
